title: Wayfarer's Toolkit
description: GM tools for dnd5e: overland hex travel with off-road encounter rolls, flight routes with fares paid from a party purse (players can book flights too, with an optional departure sound), a session-start helper, MMO-style grey vendor-trash loot (lootable bodies with Item Piles), a riding feat, a classic-MMO-style character pane for equipping gear, a narrative quest log with an on-screen tracker, and an optional three-coin economy (copper, silver, gold at 100 to 1). Your campaign content stays in your world; the module supplies the logic. Every tool can be turned on or off per world.

recommends.reason: Vendor Trash turns defeated creatures into lootable piles.
Sets Item Piles up for dnd5e, which Vendor Trash's lootable piles need.
